data.body:
[P2] Isolate plugin cleanup before detaching an expired invocation

This race returns while an already-entered `onInvocationEnd` continues running. For example, invocation A can acknowledge an oversized result and return success at its deadline while its OpenTelemetry flush remains pending. Invocation B can then start sequentially using the same cached plugin instance. When A's flush resumes, both built-in OTel plugins perform span cleanup and `resetInvocationState()` against fields now belonging to B, ending or discarding B's spans and trace context. Make post-await plugin mutations invocation-scoped or generation-checked, and add a sequential two-invocation regression that releases A's flush while B is active.
